% The whole printed book.
%   python3 -I html2tex.py --book && lualatex book.tex && python3 -I html2tex.py --index && lualatex book.tex && lualatex book.tex
%   (the index step reads book.ixw from the run before it; run lualatex until the contents settle)
% A private build, so that two people can build at once (every generated file in DIR; the style, fonts, figures'
% sources and checks are read from the book; DIR/book.tex is a fresh copy of this file):
%   python3 -I tex/html2tex.py --book --out DIR
%   cd DIR && lualatex book.tex && python3 -I BOOK/tex/html2tex.py --index --out DIR && lualatex book.tex && lualatex book.tex
%   python3 -I checks/strand.py book.pdf out/*.tex && python3 -I checks/labs.py book.pdf && python3 -I checks/boxes.py book.pdf   (still in DIR)
% One chapter in private:  python3 -I tex/html2tex.py maps --out DIR  &&  cd DIR && lualatex sample.tex && lualatex sample.tex
\documentclass[twoside,openright]{book}
\usepackage{ebpfbook}
\graphicspath{{out/}}
\hypersetup{pdftitle={eBPF for Systems Engineers},pdfauthor={Mohammad Shehar Yaar Tausif},pdfsubject={Linux v7.2, November 2026}}
\begin{document}
